# Oliefald og godkendt arbejdsmarkedsrapport fra USA - investorerne er igen klar til køb

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode (Euroinvestor, Monday 9 Nov 2026) covers falling oil prices on Iran-US de-escalation hopes, a stronger-than-expected US jobs report (165k jobs vs 65k expected) and a US 10-year yield around 4.85%. Guest strategist Henrik Henriksen (Petersen & Partners) stays cautious on the AI and semiconductor rally. He calls it a bubble that is starting to burst and expects sideways markets with sector rotation. He suggests real estate stocks could become interesting if interest rates have peaked, and equal-weighted indices as a hedge against concentration risk. The panel is positive about Nordea getting clarity on its money-laundering verdict, and negative on CoreWeave and on Nvidia after the Jensen Huang scandal.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

In a falling trend since its May peak; Lars says he will downgrade it and has nothing he wants to buy.

#### Reasoning

Host Lars Persson's technical view: CoreWeave has fallen sharply and is a symptom of over-indebted pockets of the AI build-out. Guest Henriksen adds context: credit spreads are widening, politics around data centres is turning hostile and AI momentum has peaked.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the trend reverses after the earnings report
- if credit conditions for data-centre builders ease

> *"Så den har jo været kedelig siden Maj måned, hvor den toppede Og været i en faldende trend siden"*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

CEO scandal 'scratches the paint' short term; CEO exit could trigger an expectations reset; semiconductor cycle seen as having peaked.

#### Reasoning

The panel sees short-term headline risk from the Jensen Huang affair; if it becomes a US-China espionage case it could escalate. Guest Henriksen thinks the semiconductor sector has topped (revenue multiples were 16x versus an 8x old peak), so he is not investing for a rebound.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Jensen Huang is forced out
- if the case escalates to a US-China security issue

> *"det giver jo nogle ridser i lakken lige til Nvidia på den korte bane"*

---

### 🟡 NDA-DK — Nordea | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Money-laundering verdict puts a lid on uncertainty; panel expects investors to react positively. Henrik says the bank party isn't over yet.

#### Reasoning

Panelist Michelle and host Lars see removal of legal uncertainty as positive, as it was for Danske Bank. Guest Henriksen says Nordic banks still have support, but the 'turbo' fades if rates have peaked. A large fine could weigh on the stock and buybacks are paused.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the fine is far above DKK 16.5bn
- if rates peak and fall, removing the bank tailwind
- if buybacks stay paused for a long time

> *"Og festen er nok ikke slut i nu. Selvfølgelig også, hvis der kommer et positivt udfald fra Nordea."*

---

### 🟠 NTG — NTG Nordic Transport Group | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Strong momentum (160→340); results due today; Lars notes mid-caps can run hard.

#### Reasoning

Host Lars notes strong momentum and better operating control at NTG, but takes no explicit position ahead of the report: 'we'll see what they announce'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the report disappoints
- if transport-sector weakness persists

> *"Den lavede en bundformation under 160 i foråret, og nu ligger den og handles 340."*
